title: Machines and Responsibility
goal: I can say that a machine acts as if it understood (*úgy válaszol, mintha értené*).
I can say that responsibility grows with power (*minél erősebb a technika, annál nagyobb a felelősség*).
I can say in a few sentences what Neumann János wrote about technology.
